title: 3D Architectural Landscape Artist
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **3D Landscape Artist** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for creating high-quality interior and exterior landscape visualizations for architectural and real-estate projects. The ideal candidate should have strong artistic skills, a good understanding of environment design, and expertise in 3D visualization software.

**Responsibilities**

* Create realistic 3D landscape designs for interior and exterior environments.
* Develop high-quality architectural visualizations, including gardens, outdoor spaces, terraces, pathways, parks, and surrounding environments.
* Work closely with architects, designers, and the creative team to understand project requirements.
* Model, texture,and render scenes with realistic detailing.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 2–5 years of experience in 3D landscape visualization or architectural visualization.
* Strong knowledge of landscape composition, environment creation, and realistic rendering.
* Proficiency in software such as:
* Autodesk 3ds Max
* V-Ray / Corona Renderer
* SketchUp

**Employment Details**

* **Position:** Full-Time
* **Location:** Kolkata (On-site)
* **Department:** Architectural Visualization / Landscape Design

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Principal / Senior Structural Design Engineer
description:
Principal / Senior Structural Design Engineer

**About Nightingale Group of Companies :**

Nightingale Group of Companies is a diversified enterprise with a strong presence in healthcare, infrastructure, engineering, tea manufacturing, and tourism. The Group consists of **Archtech Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (ACPL)**, delivering master planning, engineering design, and project management, and **Civil Engineers Enterprises Pvt. Ltd.**, an EPC contractor executing turnkey infrastructure projects.

Nightingale Hospital is known for advanced medical care, while Nightingale Tea owns premium tea estates in West Bengal offering tea manufacturing and tourism experiences. With nearly four decades of excellence, Nightingale Group blends tradition with innovation to create sustainable value and impactful projects.

**Job Summary:**

**Archtech Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (ACPL)** is seeking a seasoned **Principal / Senior Structural Design Engineer** with a minimum of **15 years of experience** to lead our structural engineering division in Kolkata. The ideal candidate will spearhead structural analysis, complex design execution, technical mentorship, and quality assurance across large-scale commercial, institutional, high-rise, and infrastructure projects.

* **Job Type:** Full-time

* **Location:** 11, Shakespeare Sarani, Kolkata - 700071, West Bengal

* **Experience Required:** Minimum 15 years in Structural Design & Engineering Consultancy

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership:** Lead the structural engineering team in conceptualizing, analyzing, and designing complex RCC, Steel, and Composite structures (High-rise buildings, institutional complexes, commercial hubs, and industrial infrastructure).

* **Design Validation & Proof Checking:** Review, verify, and approve structural design calculations, Design Basis Reports (DBRs), and Good for Construction (GFC) drawings prepared by junior and mid-level engineers.

* **Value Engineering:** Optimize structural systems for safety, constructability, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness without compromising engineering integrity.

* **Code Compliance & Standards:** Ensure strict adherence to Indian Standard Codes (IS 456, IS 800, IS 1893, IS 13920, IS 875), National Building Code (NBC), and relevant international standards (ACI, Eurocodes) where applicable.

* **Multidisciplinary Coordination:** Collaborate closely with principal architects, MEP leads, geotechnical consultants, and EPC execution teams to resolve complex structural interfaces.

* **Client & Authority Representation:** Represent the firm in high-level technical meetings with clients, proof-checking authorities, and statutory bodies.

* **Mentorship:** Guide, mentor, and build technical capabilities within the internal structural design team.

**Qualifications & Technical Requirements**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering is mandatory; **M.E. / M.Tech in Structural Engineering** is strongly preferred.

* **Experience:** Minimum **15 years of proven experience** in a reputed civil/structural engineering consultancy firm, with substantial experience in a team-lead or senior technical role.

* **Software Mastery:** Expert-level command over structural analysis and design software including **ETABS, STAAD.Pro, SAFE, and SAP2000**, along with working oversight of **AutoCAD** and **Revit Structure**.

* **Specialized Knowledge:** Strong grasp of seismic analysis, wind tunnel/dynamic analysis, deep foundation systems (piles, raft foundations), and retrofitting/rehabilitation of structures. Experience with hill structures or specialized institutional projects is an added advantage.

**What We Offer**

* A leadership role at the helm of prestigious, large-scale engineering and infrastructure projects.

* A stable, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating work environment backed by nearly four decades of organizational legacy.

* Compensation and benefits package commensurate with senior industry leadership standards.

**How to Apply**Interested candidates meeting the 15+ years experience criterion may apply directly through **Indeed** or send their detailed CV along with a summary of major structural projects led to **admin@archtechconsultants.com** (Subject: *Application for Senior Structural Design Engineer - 15+ Yrs*).

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Project Engineer (Civil)
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Civil Project Manager** to independently manage end-to-end industrial warehouse construction projects, covering planning, design, budgeting, tendering, execution, contractor management, quality control and final handover.

Key Responsibilities

* Planning & Development: Plan warehouse layouts, assess sites, evaluate feasibility and coordinate with architects and structural consultants.
* Design & Drawings: Prepare, review and interpret 2D/3D civil, architectural and structural drawings.
* Costing & Budgeting: Prepare BOQs, detailed cost estimates, project budgets and cost-control reports.
* Project Execution: Develop project schedules, monitor progress and ensure timely and cost-effective completion.
* Site Management: Supervise site engineers, contractors, subcontractors, manpower and materials across multiple locations.
* Tendering & Vendor Management: Float tenders, evaluate quotations, prepare technical and commercial comparisons, negotiate and recommend vendors.
* Commercial Management: Prepare/review Work Orders and Purchase Orders; verify RA bills, final bills, measurements and variation claims.
* Quality & Safety: Ensure construction quality, compliance with specifications and adherence to approved drawings.
* Scheduling & Monitoring: Prepare Gantt charts, bar charts and milestone schedules; track planned versus actual progress.
* MIS & Reporting: Maintain DPRs, weekly/monthly progress reports, project budgets, financial records and management MIS.

Technical Skills & Software

* AutoCAD 2D & 3D
* Revit / BIM (Basic knowledge)
* Primavera P6 / MS Project
* MS Excel – BOQ, estimation, budgeting and MIS
* Tendering, WO/PO preparation and contractor bill verification
* DPR, project scheduling and progress reporting

Desired Experience & Expertise

* 5–12 years of experience in civil construction/project management.
* Experience in warehouses, industrial buildings, factories or commercial projects.
* Knowledge of PEB and RCC construction.
* Strong expertise in estimation, BOQ, tendering and contract management.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and site teams.
* Strong technical, commercial, analytical and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel to project locations.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do u have?
* What is your Current CTC ?
* What is your expected CTC ?

Location:

* Kolkata, West Bengal (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: AI Video Maker
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION AI Video Creator & Architectural Visualisation Artist Company: Arcwell Architecture Location: New Town, Kolkata Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 1–3 years preferred; talented freshers may apply About Arcwell Architecture Arcwell Architecture is a design-focused architectural firm specialising in residential, commercial, and interior design projects. We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy AI Video Creator who can transform architectural designs, 3D renders, and SketchUp models into engaging, cinematic videos using AI tools and professional video-editing software. Key Responsibilities - Create AI-generated architectural videos, cinematic walkthroughs, and project reveal videos. - Convert still renders and 3D visualisations into realistic animations using AI video-generation tools. - Create promotional reels, YouTube Shorts, Instagram videos, and other social media content. - Develop cinematic sequences featuring realistic camera movements, lighting, landscaping, people, and environmental effects. - Work with architectural drawings, SketchUp models, renders, and reference images. - Use AI tools to enhance visual quality, create transitions, and generate engaging storytelling content. - Edit videos with professional colour grading, music, sound effects, subtitles, and branding. - Create project presentations, marketing videos, and before-and-after renovation videos. - Maintain the original architectural design, building geometry, and material intent while creating animations. - Coordinate with architects and the marketing team to deliver content within deadlines. Required Skills - Knowledge of AI video-generation tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, Luma AI, or similar platforms. - Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. - Experience with AI image-generation and enhancement tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or similar platforms. - Understanding of architectural visualisation, composition, perspective, lighting, and camera movement. - Ability to create high-quality vertical reels (9:16) and cinematic videos (16:9). - Creative storytelling skills and a good understanding of social media trends. - Ability to follow architectural references accurately and maintain visual consistency across video sequences. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in an architecture, interior design, real estate, or visualisation studio. - Knowledge of SketchUp, Lumion, D5 Render, Twinmotion, V-Ray, or Unreal Engine. - Experience creating realistic exterior and interior walkthroughs. - A portfolio demonstrating AI-generated videos, architectural animations, or cinematic reels. Performance Expectations - Deliver high-quality architectural videos and social media content consistently. - Produce visually realistic, engaging, and brand-aligned content. - Demonstrate creativity while preserving design accuracy. - Meet project deadlines and respond effectively to feedback. Salary & Benefits - Salary: Based on experience, skills, and portfolio. - Opportunity to work on premium residential and commercial architectural projects. - Creative freedom to experiment with emerging AI technologies. - Professional growth in AI-assisted architectural visualisation and digital marketing. How to Apply Interested candidates should share their CV, portfolio, and links to their best AI-generated videos or architectural reels. Email: [Insert company email] Contact: [Insert contact number] Join Arcwell Architecture and turn architectural visions into cinematic experiences.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:
